definitions: To exaggerate the importance or seriousness of a minor problem or difficulty.
To treat a trivial matter as if it were a major crisis.
examples: Don't make a mountain out of a molehill; it's just a scratch.
She tends to make a mountain out of a molehill over small disagreements.
It's not worth making a mountain out of a molehill about the spilled milk.
lemma: make a mountain out of a molehill
source: make a mountain out of a molehill
